nodes.label: devtools-echart chart host
nodes.rationale: ECharts draws into the host element itself, so the :host { display: block } style is what gives it a box to draw in.

nodes.label: Deliberately empty template file
nodes.rationale: The file exists rather than an inline empty string so every component in the tree is read the same way: markup lives in the .html beside it and there is no second place to look.
